title: REEDIT IS THE FRONT PAGE — HUD globe becomes the MINIMAP. Interaction fills the screen.
summary: REEDIT becomes the front page of Gaia. When anyone lands on primals.eco, they see the Q&A forum, art, commissions — the SOCIAL SURFACE. The globe/orrery/HUD moves to the corner as a MINIMAP — a radar of the organism's internal state. The actual screen IS the interaction space. This is the inversion: the organism was the whole view, now it's the awareness widget while the WORLD fills the screen. Study gaming minimaps to get funky with it.

the_inversion.before: Globe/orrery = full screen. Social features = hidden panels.
the_inversion.after: REEDIT + Q&A + Art = full screen. Globe/orrery = minimap in bottom-right corner.
the_inversion.why: Random humans don't land on primals.eco to see a spinning globe. They come to INTERACT. The globe is Gaia's self-awareness — important but not the main event. The main event is the CONVERSATION.
the_inversion.metaphor: Your whole world was your bedroom. Then you discovered outside. The bedroom didn't shrink — the world grew. The globe IS the bedroom. REEDIT IS the outside.

gaming_minimaps.study: How do the best games handle the minimap? What works? What's funky?

examples.minimap: Bottom-left circle. Radar style. Shows nearby threats, objectives, terrain.
examples.lesson: The CIRCLE is natural. The organism IS a circle. Put it in the corner and let it pulse.

examples.minimap: Top-center compass strip. Shows direction to quests/locations.
examples.lesson: A STRIP not a map. Just direction + distance. Minimal. The compass IS the spine.

examples.minimap: NONE. Navigate by memory and pain.
examples.lesson: No minimap = maximum immersion. But also maximum death. Trust vs convenience.

examples.minimap: Bottom-right circle. Stamp-based — YOU mark what matters.
examples.lesson: The USER decides what's on the map. Stamps = bookmarks = personal cartography.

examples.minimap: Full map when opened, compass when closed. Sites of grace glow.
examples.lesson: The minimap BREATHES. Collapsed = compass. Expanded = full territory. Two states like CIS/TRANS.

examples.minimap: Top-right rectangle. Threat indicators. GPS routing.
examples.lesson: Too much info = clutter. The minimap should show STATE not DETAIL.

examples.minimap: DIEGETIC. The line on the floor IS the navigation. No overlay.
examples.lesson: The best minimap is IN THE WORLD not on top of it. The giggle bubbles ARE diegetic navigation.

examples.minimap: Bottom-right. Squad icons. Territory boundaries. Simple.
examples.lesson: The squad IS the minimap. 16 primals as dots on a circle. Their positions = the state.

gaming_minimaps.chosen_approach: Bottom-right. Circle (like GTA radar). Pulsing (like heartbeat). Collapsible (like Elden Ring). Diegetic elements (like Dead Space). The globe shrinks to a radar widget showing: primals as dots, heartbeat as pulse, generation hash, spine signal count.

reedit_as_front_page.anyone_can_post: No account needed. Anonymous. POST to spine. Context = currency.
reedit_as_front_page.gaia_responds: Gaia always attempts a first answer. Confidence shown. Humans correct. She learns.

minimap_spec.element: Circular div, ~120px diameter, fixed bottom-right, z-index 999
minimap_spec.content: Canvas rendering: globe dots for primals, heartbeat sine wave, generation hash text
minimap_spec.interaction: Click to expand to full globe view. Click again to collapse. Escape collapses.
minimap_spec.pulse: Border pulses with heartbeat. Green = alive. Red = spine down. Gold = new signal.
